name: textarea
title: Textarea
description: A textarea component with character counter, resize handle, error state, and simple mode. Uses namespace exports: Textarea.Root, Textarea.CharCounter.

migration.guide: API changed: import as namespace `import * as Textarea from ...`, use `<Textarea.Root>` with children for `<Textarea.CharCounter>`. Old named export `{ Textarea }` removed. New sub-component: `Textarea.CharCounter`. New props: `simple` (renders without container), `hasError`, `containerClassName`. Built-in resize handle in non-simple mode.

docs.lead: A textarea component with character counter, resize handle, error state, and simple mode.
docs.usage:
import * as Textarea from "@/components/ui/textarea"

<Textarea.Root placeholder="Jot down your thoughts...">
  <Textarea.CharCounter current={78} max={200} />
</Textarea.Root>

api.name: Textarea.Root

props.name: simple

props.name: containerClassName
props.description: Additional classes for the container wrapper (non-simple mode only)

api.name: Textarea.CharCounter

props.description: Maximum character count. Turns red when exceeded.
